notes.learning: From 'ìmọ̀' (knowledge) + 'ọrọ̀-ajé' (wealth/finance). Refers to the social science concerned with production, distribution, and consumption of goods and services.

examples: Ìmọ̀ ọrọ̀-ajé ń ṣàlàyé bí ọjà ṣe ń ṣiṣẹ́. (Economics explains how markets work)
Ó ní oyè nínú ìmọ̀ ọrọ̀-ajé. (She has a degree in economics)
data.subject: Economics
